content_text:
I am an amateur photographer and don’t have many skills and equipment is an iPhone XR, but I am eager to learn more and try to film more about cars.
I love cars, love the reflection from metal, and the lines from the body.
This is the result:
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/KLq-b2n7wLU
Not even close to being professional, but while I film cars, it makes me excited and digs me in.
Hope I can learn more from professionals, that would be great.
Light the road,
light the future.
